threads.title: The Word who made all things
threads.blurb: The Creator of Genesis 1 is named in John 1: the Word who was with God, was God, and became flesh.

threads.title: I AM, God with us
threads.blurb: The name God gave Moses at the bush, spoken by Jesus before the crowd, and confessed by Thomas: my Lord and my God.

threads.title: The First and the Last
threads.blurb: The LORD calls Himself the first and the last in Isaiah. In Revelation the risen Jesus takes the same title.

threads.title: The Son of God
threads.blurb: Thou art my Son, says Psalm 2. The Father says it again over the Jordan, and Peter confesses it.

threads.title: The Prophet like Moses
threads.blurb: Moses promised a prophet God would raise up from among the people. Peter and Stephen name Him.

threads.title: The Good Shepherd
threads.blurb: The LORD is my shepherd. Jesus says: I am the good shepherd, and I lay down my life for the sheep.

threads.title: The Light of the world
threads.blurb: Let there be light, on the first day. The people that walked in darkness see a great light, and the city needs no sun.

threads.title: The Seed of the woman
threads.blurb: The first promise of a Saviour, given in the garden and kept in the fullness of time.

threads.title: Born of a virgin in Bethlehem
threads.blurb: Isaiah foretold the virgin's son and Micah named the town, seven hundred years before the night in Luke 2.

threads.title: The Son of David on an endless throne
threads.blurb: God promised David a son whose kingdom would never end. Gabriel tells Mary it is hers.

threads.title: A voice in the wilderness
threads.blurb: Isaiah and Malachi promised a messenger to prepare the way. John the Baptist is that voice.

threads.title: Your King comes on a donkey
threads.blurb: Jacob's blessing of Judah and Zechariah's lowly King meet at the gates of Jerusalem.

threads.title: Betrayed for thirty pieces of silver
threads.blurb: A familiar friend lifts up his heel, and the price is weighed out exactly as Zechariah wrote.

threads.title: The Lamb of God
threads.blurb: God will provide himself a lamb, said Abraham. John the Baptist points to Jesus: Behold the Lamb of God.

threads.title: The Suffering Servant
threads.blurb: Isaiah 53 describes the one wounded for our transgressions. Philip begins at that scripture and preaches Jesus.

threads.title: Psalm 22 at the cross
threads.blurb: David's psalm of the forsaken one, from the first cry to the divided garments, fulfilled at Calvary.

threads.title: They shall look on Him whom they pierced
threads.blurb: Pierced hands and feet in the Psalms, a pierced side at the cross, and every eye seeing Him when He returns.

threads.title: Not a bone broken
threads.blurb: The Passover lamb's bones were not to be broken. The soldiers broke the legs of the others, but not His.

threads.title: Lifted up like the serpent
threads.blurb: Whoever looked at the bronze serpent lived. So the Son of man must be lifted up.

threads.title: Raised on the third day
threads.blurb: Thou wilt not leave my soul in hell. Jonah's three days, and an empty tomb according to the scriptures.

threads.title: Seated at the right hand
threads.blurb: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand. Daniel saw the Son of man given an everlasting dominion.

threads.title: A priest after Melchizedek
threads.blurb: The priest-king who met Abraham with bread and wine points to a High Priest who lives for ever.

threads.title: The stone the builders rejected
threads.blurb: The rejected stone becomes the head of the corner, the tried and precious foundation laid in Zion.

threads.title: The just shall live by faith
threads.blurb: Abraham believed God and it was counted to him for righteousness. Saved by grace through faith.

threads.title: The new covenant
threads.blurb: I will write my law in their hearts, promised through Jeremiah, sealed in the cup at the Last Supper.

threads.title: Living water
threads.blurb: The fountain of living waters, the river from the temple, and the water Jesus gives that ends all thirst.

threads.title: The Spirit poured out
threads.blurb: I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh. Jesus promised the Comforter, and Pentecost came.

threads.title: The tree of life
threads.blurb: Lost in the garden of Eden, guarded by cherubims, and found again beside the river in the holy city.

threads.title: A new heaven and a new earth
threads.blurb: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth, and at the end He makes all things new.

threads.title: He is coming again
threads.blurb: This same Jesus shall so come in like manner. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
